title: On a small screen tiles show View Report instead of View details
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You are in a location (workplace) that has invoices and technician clocked time over the last twelve months.
  3. You have a small screen: a phone, a tablet held upright, or a desktop browser window made narrower than 1024 pixels (the tiles stack into one column once it is narrow enough).
  4. You also have a desktop window at least 1024 pixels wide.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, switch the Revenue and Technician Efficiency pills to Last 12 Months: both show figures; then set both back to This Month (the dashboard remembers your choices in this browser). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
custom_steps:
1. On the desktop window, look over the whole dashboard for an "expand all", "collapse all" or view-style (panel or inline) control.
  2. Click Dashboard in the top menu on the small screen.
  3. Look at the foot of each of the six tiles.
  4. Tap "View Report" on the Revenue tile, then go back.
  5. Tap the Revenue tile's body (name, headline, trend line).
  6. Look at the foot of the At Risk Customers tile.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • There is no "expand all" or "collapse all" control and no choice between a panel view and an inline view.
  • On the small screen the tiles stack in one column and none can be opened in place: tapping a tile's body opens nothing.
  • The five tiles other than At Risk show a "View Report" link (with a small arrow icon) at their foot instead of "View details". Tapping it opens that tile's full report (Revenue opens the Sales report).
  • At Risk Customers has no link at its foot. Its detail table can only be opened on a desktop-width screen.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 6. Design canvas board 14_Phone_After (row 14, 390 pixels wide).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-N1: “The dashboard has no "expand all" or "collapse all" control.”
  • S6-N2: “The dashboard has no Panel-versus-Inline view choice.”
  • S6-E1: “On a small screen (see Terminology), a tile cannot be expanded in place.”
  • S6-E2: “On a small screen, in place of the "View details" control, the tile's footer is a "View Report" link that opens the tile's full report.”
  • S6-E3: “On a small screen, the At Risk Customers tile shows no footer link, because it has no report to open (S10-N1); its detail table is reachable only on a desktop screen.”
  • Terminology (small screen): “a browser viewport less than 1024 pixels wide, measured by the width of the browser window, not the physical device.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
